sources.title_original: Samsung Foundry updates process roadmap to move 1.4nm node to 2029 — high-NA EUV will enable 1nm-class and smaller nodes in 2030 and beyond
sources.summary: Samsung Foundry has delayed its 1.4nm-class node to 2029, making SF2 one of its longest-lasting process technologies ever. The company also aims to start using High-NA EUV for its 1nm-class process technology in 2030.
sources.summary_zh: 三星代工已将其 1.4 纳米级节点推迟到 2029 年，这使得 SF2 成为其历史上最持久的工艺技术之一。该公司还计划在 2030 年开始在其 1 纳米级工艺技术中使用高数值孔径 EUV。
